text: In summer 2017, Transportation Services conducted a study for all-way stop control at Dewbourne Avenue and Glenayr Road. Stop control was not recommended as warrants were not satisfied. However, in October 2017 I received a petition from local residents requesting all-way stop control at this intersection, with nearly 100 percent of homes on each of the surrounding blocks in support of this proposal.
Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of Dewbourne Avenue and Glenayr Road.
